note:
Built from three sources, none of which holds the night alone. No release covers 11/2/77 as a show: Dave's Picks 12 carries ten of its songs as bonus tracks behind the 11/4 Colgate concert, and Dick's Picks 34 carries seven more behind 11/5. Dave's Picks 12's article prints the full DeadBase setlist and marks which release holds each song — [A] for its own ten, [B] for Dick's Picks 34's seven — which is what makes the assembly checkable rather than a guess.

That leaves four songs on no release at all: Samson and Delilah, Ship of Fools, Good Lovin' and Sunrise, the middle of the second set. They take their timings from gd77-11-02.sbd.samaritano.14743.sbeok.shnf, which carries the whole night and confirms the running order. Twenty-one songs, complete.

The importer cannot do this on its own. The bonus block in Dave's Picks 12 is headed ":''Seneca College Field House bonus tracks:''" — a venue, not a date — so the ten tracks orphan rather than resolving to 11/2, which is correct behaviour and also why this show had to be assembled by hand.
